source_text:
μαθημάτων, ἤδη πέντε ἔτεσιν αὐτῷ προσκαρτερήσαντα πρὶν ἢ ἐμὲ ἄρξασθαι ἀκούειν
ἐκείνων τῶν λόγων· δι' ὃν καὶ πρότερον κοινῇ ἐσθῆτι χρώμενος ἀποδυσάμενος καὶ
φιλόσοφον ἀναλαβὼν σχῆμα μέχρι τοῦ δεῦρο τηρεῖ βιβλία τε Ἑλλήνων κατὰ
δύναμιν οὐ παύεται φιλολογῶν.
thought_title: Heraclas's philosophical training and continuing practice
orientation: Origen is describing Heraclas, now a presbyter of Alexandria, whom he found at the teacher of philosophical learning.
pass_a_gloss: of learning, already for five years having persevered with him before I began to hear those discourses; on account of whom also formerly using common clothing, having taken it off and having put on the philosopher's garb, until now he keeps it, and Greek books to the best of his ability he does not cease studying.

choices.why: The verb means to persist or remain devotedly with someone; 'persevered' keeps the durative force of the perfective participle.
The middle voice indicates he removed the clothing from himself; 'stripped it off' preserves the reflexive force.
Glossary term; 'garb' captures the distinctive clothing of a philosopher.
Glossary term; the verb means engaging in literary study, and the context specifies Greek books.
The present tense with negation conveys ongoing, uninterrupted action; 'does not cease' preserves the litotes.

pass_b_english: Heraclas had already persevered with him for five years before I began to hear those lectures. Because of this, Heraclas had earlier taken off the common clothing he was wearing and put on the philosopher's garb, which he keeps to this day, and he does not cease studying the books of the Greeks to the best of his ability.

last_rejected.quote: studying the books of the Greeks
last_rejected.why: Glossary fixes 'φιλολογῶν' as 'studying books', not 'studying the books of the Greeks'.
last_rejected.fix: and he does not cease studying books of the Greeks as much as he can.
last_rejected.ruling: φιλολογῶν means 'studying books'; 'the books of the Greeks' comes from βιβλία Ἑλλήνων. No glossary break.
